notes: family: trick-taking-prediction-area-scoring. Each won trick scores +1; paradox causer scores -1 per won trick and no bonus. In 3–5 players an exact bid grants largest orthogonally connected token group. In two players there is no bid: at most four won tricks qualifies for that bonus, unless causing paradox. Enter zero for all unused round rows; predicted=0 is a placeholder only in two-player mode. Round count depends on players; schema has no dynamic rounds.count.
